## Changes since `v0.7.2-beta.12`

### Features

- offer "Open as root with sudo" beside a "Permission denied" in the SFTP drawer: the drawer, working as the user, then switches to root and opens as root the folder the user was refused, which is not the one in view, since the drawer stays where it was when a folder cannot be opened; the loader keeps that folder for it; the drawer's error moves into SftpErrorAlert, which keeps index.tsx clear of its 500-line limit ([2223ee32](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/2223ee32a9265ed54790e86155c59455aa53322f))
- add a sudo switch to the SFTP drawer, beside its name, that makes the drawer work on the host as root: switched on it reads "root" in the destructive color and the header carries a red line along its top, every request of the drawer asks the backend for root, and the folder in view loads again as root; a switch sudo refuses or the user cancels goes back to working as the user and keeps the error in view; switched off, a folder only root could read gives way to the drawer's first folder; the switch starts off whenever the tab opens; a file opened from a drawer in sudo mode is read and saved as root, says "root" beside its name in the editor, and gets a tab apart from the same file opened as the user ([3a58bef7](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/3a58bef7e8dd2f0cae15b958d525a04b9da39bba))
- ask for the sudo password when the file manager opens a host as root and none is saved: the tab's sign-in dialog asks with the title "sudo password", and again, saying sudo turned the last one down, up to three times as sudo itself does; a saved password sudo refuses is followed by the question too, and a connection with sudo prompt filling turned off is always asked; the password stays in memory with the connection until it closes; only sudo's own steps are bounded by the channel timeout now, so a user taking their time to type is not cut off ([c105637f](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/c105637f14148c5acc140b95c2c4dc4cfaea83a1))
- let an SFTP connection work on the host as root through sudo, asked for with sftpSudo on the connection: such a connection pools apart from the user's, finds out once with sudo -k -n true whether the account needs a password, checks the saved sudo or login password with sudo -v on a channel whose input then ends so a wrong one fails at once, and starts every channel, the control session, the transfer lanes and the scripts for archives, search and command delete, as sudo -k with the password as the first line of its input, sending nothing on until the command run as root prints a ready line, so the password never reaches sftp-server and sudo's messages never reach the protocol; sftp-server is found where sshd_config names it, then where distributions install it; refusals are told apart by the step they happen at, since sudo 1.9 and sudo-rs word them differently, and keep sudo's own words; a folder seen as root is not saved as the last one; the tests in sudo/host_tests.rs run the handshake against scripts/sudo-test-host, whose accounts cover a password, NOPASSWD with fish, sudo for systemctl only, no sudo, and requiretty, and pass with sudo 1.9.15 and sudo-rs 0.2.13 ([237b619c](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/237b619c8798166197dd341d777b203bf3678928))

### Fixes

- take the connection dialog to the field that stops Connect: the webview does not always show the browser's validation bubble, so a missing host or an out-of-range port left Connect looking dead; the first invalid field is now scrolled to, focused, outlined and named in a toast, and a duplicate name or a bad jump host field is scrolled to as well ([c68db8df](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/c68db8df8445b4e01276f4bca13ff34a2a623086))
- keep a pooled SFTP connection after an error the server answered: with_sftp! closed the tab's connection after any failed request, so opening a missing path or a file the account may not read cost a reconnect, and in the file manager's sudo mode another sudo password prompt; a failed request now first checks with canonicalize(".") whether the session still answers, within 5 seconds, and only a session that does not is closed ([e876df1c](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/e876df1c78a57d5ca7ecaa28fb951f3efc9f16b4))
- keep guessing typing on a slow link after Enter or Tab: the keys typed after a key the predictor can't guess were placed at a cursor that keys still on their way had not moved yet, so when those keys' echo arrived the line looked like a password prompt masking with *, and nothing more on it was guessed until Enter; typing the next command before the prompt returned, or typing on after a Tab completion, lost the guesses for the whole line; the keys after such a key are now placed tentatively, hidden and moved to follow the line until one is echoed where placed, and a key typed as the character a tentative guess was echoed as does not count as the row echoing, so a password with * in it stays hidden ([23e01eac](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/23e01eac16340d2f7307b473b13516d02fadec92))

### UI and usability

- widen the gap between split panes from 5 px to 8 px: at 5 px the panes ran into each other and the divider was hard to grab; the divider's line keeps its width, and the panes' minimum sizes follow the gap ([96db5319](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/96db5319b4769a32102c4a2ca74dbaf655b3ba3b))

### Security

- create the editor's temporary save file with the original's read, write and execute bits: the save wrote the new contents to a temporary file beside the original with no mode, so OpenSSH's sftp-server created it 0644 and a 0600 file's new contents sat readable by every user until the save finished, which a sudo editor would do for /etc/shadow; the setuid, setgid and sticky bits wait until the save is done, and on a server whose rename overwrites the original, the save now sets the original's owner, then its mode, back on the file the rename left, each in its own request and ignored when refused, since the contents are saved by then; OpenSSH refuses such a rename and the save writes into the original as before, keeping its mode and owner; the test server records the mode each open asks for ([b216cbe0](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/b216cbe02228dac6ba11b7d2c4a8d8e7041a87e2))
